goal: Verify Admin CRUD for projects and documents, trigger reindex, automatic collection of custom RAG metrics (without RAGAS) after each query, and CSV export.
preconditions_global: Stack running: docker compose up -d — all services healthy
Project with an indexed document (status 'indexed') — save $PROJECT_ID

variables_legend.$ADMIN_TOKEN: Admin JWT token — from POST http://localhost:8000/auth/login
variables_legend.$PROJECT_ID: ObjectId of project with indexed documents
variables_legend.$NEW_PROJECT_ID: id of project created in scenario 5.1 — save from response
variables_legend.$CASCADE_PROJECT_ID: id of project with at least one document — for cascade delete test (5.5)

scenarios.title: Health check — Admin and Eval
scenarios.description: Quick verification that Admin and Eval services are responding.

scenarios.title: Admin — create project with full settings
scenarios.description: POST /admin/projects creates a project with full settings. Returns id — save as $NEW_PROJECT_ID.

steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/admin/projects -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"name": "Phase5 Test Project", "description": "E2E test project for phase 5", "chunking_strategy": "recursive", "embedding_provider": "local_bge", "rag_mode": "vanilla", "hybrid_alpha": 0.5, "top_k": 20, "rerank_top_n": 5}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/admin/projects' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"name": "Phase5 Test Project", "description": "E2E test project for phase 5", "chunking_strategy": "recursive", "embedding_provider": "local_bge", "rag_mode": "vanilla", "hybrid_alpha": 0.5, "top_k": 20, "rerank_top_n": 5}'
checks: id is a non-empty string — save as $NEW_PROJECT_ID
created_at and created_by are present in the response

scenarios.title: Admin — update project settings (PATCH /settings)
scenarios.description: PATCH /projects/{id}/settings — merge, not replace. Unmodified fields remain unchanged.

steps.action: Change rag_mode and hybrid_alpha (other fields unchanged)

scenarios.title: Admin — project document list with pagination and filtering
scenarios.description: GET /projects/{id}/documents — paginated list with optional status filter.

checks: items, total, page, limit, pages are present in the response
items[0] contains: document_id, filename, status, created_at

scenarios.title: Admin — trigger project reindex
scenarios.description: POST /projects/{id}/reindex re-emits document.uploaded events for all project documents. Restarts the entire ingestion pipeline from scratch.

checks: project_id and documents_queued are present in the response
steps.notes: Check RabbitMQ management (port 15672) that 'document.uploaded' events were published.

scenarios.title: Admin — delete project (full cascade)
scenarios.description: DELETE /projects/{id} deletes the project along with documents, chunks, conversations and Weaviate vectors. eval_results are NOT deleted.
scenarios.precondition: Create a project with at least one document (status indexed). Save as $CASCADE_PROJECT_ID.

checks: project_id, documents_deleted, chunks_deleted, conversations_deleted, vectors_deleted are present

steps.action: GET documents — empty list after deletion

cascade_scope.note: eval_results are NOT deleted — historical evaluation results are preserved for analysis

scenarios.title: Eval — log created automatically after query (production mode)
scenarios.description: Query without gold_answer → eval service saves production metrics async after query.completed event.

steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What are the risks of combining aspirin and warfarin?", "stream": false}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What are the risks of combining aspirin and warfarin?", "stream": false}'

checks: items[0].metrics contains: faithfulness, latency_ms, citation_precision, context_relevance, token_count
steps.notes: Eval service processes async — wait ~10s after the query before checking results.

scenarios.title: Eval — benchmark mode metrics (with gold_answer: token_f1, em, answer_relevance)
scenarios.description: Query with gold_answer → eval service additionally computes token_f1, em, answer_relevance.

steps.action: Send query with gold_answer → benchmark mode
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What is the warfarin and aspirin interaction?", "gold_answer": "Combining warfarin and aspirin increases the risk of bleeding due to additive anticoagulant effects.", "stream": false}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What is the warfarin and aspirin interaction?", "gold_answer": "Combining warfarin and aspirin increases the risk of bleeding due to additive anticoagulant effects.", "stream": false}'

checks: item with eval_mode == 'benchmark' contains metrics: token_f1, em, faithfulness, answer_relevance, latency_ms
all metrics in range 0.0-1.0 (exception: latency_ms as integer)
steps.notes: Eval service processes async — wait ~10s after the query.

scenarios.title: Eval — filter logs by rag_mode
scenarios.description: GET /eval/results?rag_mode=vanilla returns only results for the given RAG mode.

scenarios.title: Eval — architecture comparison table (summary)
scenarios.description: GET /eval/results/summary — aggregated metrics per rag_mode. Preview of the comparison table for Phase 7 experiments.

checks: each summary row contains: rag_mode, count, avg_faithfulness, avg_latency_ms

scenarios.title: Admin — export eval logs to CSV
scenarios.description: GET /admin/eval-results/export — downloads all evaluation results for a project as a CSV file for analysis in Python/Excel.

steps.action: Export results to CSV and check the header
checks: first line (header) contains columns: rag_mode, question, faithfulness, latency_ms, token_f1
steps.notes: The -o eval_export.csv flag saves the file locally. 'head -3' shows the header and first 2 data rows.

scenarios.title: Admin — settings options endpoint (admin form helper)
scenarios.description: GET /admin/projects/settings/options — enum metadata and constraints used by the frontend to build forms.

checks: body contains: rag_modes, chunking_strategies, embedding_providers, hybrid_alpha, top_k

cleanup.description: Delete test projects created during testing
